subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own mirroring external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if so what supported boundary should it use?
rationale: The observed bug is real at the source level, but the proposed fix would make OpenClaw write or coordinate with a third-party Open WebUI persistence model that current core code and docs do not own.

options.title: Add opt-in Open WebUI mirroring
options.body: Design a supported, disabled-by-default Open WebUI mirror with explicit config, schema/API compatibility proof, and live Docker validation for Control UI-to-Open WebUI visible history.

options.title: Keep core transcript-only
options.body: Document that external Control UI writes update OpenClaw transcript/context only, leaving Open WebUI visible-history repair to that deployment or an external integration.

options.title: Create a generic sync extension seam
options.body: Expose a narrow plugin/API hook for external visible-history stores instead of hardcoding Open WebUI database behavior in core.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in Open WebUI mirroring
recommendation.body: Design a supported, disabled-by-default Open WebUI mirror with explicit config, schema/API compatibility proof, and live Docker validation for Control UI-to-Open WebUI visible history.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the broadest recent overlap across Gateway chat/session, Control UI, docs, and maintainer merge history for this decision surface.
